description: This Java class 'SegmentNode' models a segment in a PCB (Printed Circuit Board) design, representing a segment with nodes for net, start and end points, and size, extending from a parent class PcbNode.

classes.name: SegmentNode
classes.description: Represents a segment in a PCB with connections to net, start/end points, and size, extending PcbNode.

methods.name: SegmentNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a SegmentNode with name, closing index, and child nodes, and finds associated net, start, end, and size nodes.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a given PointNode is connected to either the start or end point of this segment.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SegmentNode including net, start, and end points.
